text:
Scheme: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
Section: Overview
Atal Pension Yojana is a government-backed guaranteed pension scheme in India aimed primarily at providing old-age income security to unorganised sector workers.

Scheme: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
Section: Benefits
Subscribers receive a guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 after reaching 60 years of age, based on their contributions. The same pension amount is payable to the spouse upon the subscriber's demise, and accumulated pension wealth is returned to the nominee.

Scheme: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
Section: Eligibility
Open to all Indian citizens aged between 18 and 40 years who have a savings bank or post office account. Subscribers must not be income tax payers or members of any statutory social security scheme.

Scheme: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
Section: Documents
Aadhaar card, active savings bank account passbook with auto-debit consent, nominee details, and an active mobile number.

Scheme: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
Section: Application
Visit the bank branch or post office where your savings account is held, fill out the APY registration form specifying your desired pension tier, submit auto-debit instructions, and receive your PRAN acknowledgement slip.

Scheme: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)
Section: Overview
IGNOAPS is a non-contributory old-age pension component under the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) providing social security and monthly financial sustenance to impoverished elderly citizens.

metadata.schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)

text:
Scheme: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)
Section: Benefits
Provides a central monthly pension of ₹200 per month for beneficiaries aged 60 to 79 years, and ₹500 per month for beneficiaries aged 80 years and above. Many state governments augment this base amount with state contributions up to ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 per month.

metadata.schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)

text:
Scheme: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)
Section: Eligibility
Applicants must be 60 years of age or older and must belong to a household living below the poverty line (BPL) according to criteria prescribed by the Government of India.

metadata.schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)

text:
Scheme: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)
Section: Documents
Aadhaar card, BPL ration card or verified proof of BPL status, age verification certificate (birth certificate, voter card, or school leaving certificate), and bank or post office passbook.

metadata.schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)

text:
Scheme: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)
Section: Application
Apply through the local Gram Panchayat in rural areas or Municipal Ward Office in urban areas. Submit application with BPL proof and age proof. Verification is conducted by local revenue/social welfare officers before district sanction.

metadata.schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)

text:
Scheme: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
Section: Overview
The Kisan Credit Card scheme provides farmers with timely access to affordable institutional credit for crop cultivation, farm maintenance, allied agricultural activities, and urgent post-harvest capital requirements.

Scheme: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
Section: Benefits
Provides a revolving credit facility up to ₹3,00,000 at a concessional interest rate of 4% per annum (with timely repayment incentives). Withdrawals are streamlined through an ATM-enabled RuPay debit card, and built-in crop and asset insurance protection is included.

Scheme: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
Section: Eligibility
Open to all farmers including owner cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, oral lessees, self-help groups (SHGs), and joint liability groups (JLGs) of farmers, as well as animal husbandry and fisheries workers.

Scheme: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
Section: Documents
Completed and signed KCC application form, identity and residence proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN), land ownership records or tenancy agreement (Khasra, Khatauni, Pahani), and passport-size photographs.

Scheme: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
Section: Application
Obtain and complete the KCC application from your local bank branch, cooperative bank, or download from the bank portal. Submit along with land cultivation proof. The bank conducts land verification and issues the KCC RuPay card within 14 working days.

Scheme: PM-DAKSH
Section: Overview
PM-DAKSH is a skill-development programme of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment for specified marginalised groups. It offers upskilling, reskilling, short-term training, and entrepreneurial-development courses.

Scheme: PM-DAKSH
Section: Benefits
Official myScheme information states that training is provided free of cost, with a stipend during training where applicable. Successful candidates receive certification, and the programme provides post-training support for employment or self-employment opportunities.

Scheme: PM-DAKSH
Section: Eligibility
Official eligibility includes Indian nationals aged 18 to 45 from the specified SC, OBC, EWS, DNT, or Safai Mitra groups. Income and other requirements vary by category; confirm the current rules before applying.

Scheme: PM-DAKSH
Section: Documents
Official information lists documents such as Aadhaar where applicable, photograph, caste or community certificate, income certificate where applicable, age and residence proof, educational documents, and Aadhaar-linked bank details.

Scheme: PM-DAKSH
Section: Application
Register as a Learner or Participant on the Skill India Digital Hub, verify the profile through the required process, and follow the current PM-DAKSH application guidance.

Scheme: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
Section: Overview
PM-KISAN is a Central Sector scheme funded by the Government of India. It provides income support to eligible landholding farmer families.

Scheme: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
Section: Benefits
Eligible landholding farmer families receive income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal instalments. The money is transferred directly to beneficiaries' bank accounts.

Scheme: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
Section: Eligibility
The scheme covers landholding farmer families as identified under the scheme guidelines and State or Union Territory land records. A farmer family means husband, wife, and minor children who own cultivable land. Institutional landholders and several higher-economic-status categories are excluded. Final eligibility is determined under the official scheme guidelines and by the relevant authorities.

Scheme: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
Section: Documents
Official guidance says beneficiary records include name, age, gender, category, Aadhaar number or Aadhaar enrolment number where applicable, bank account number, and IFSC code. The State or Union Territory may require prescribed identity documents where Aadhaar is unavailable.

Scheme: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
Section: Application
Use the New Farmer Registration service on the official PM-KISAN portal. The State or Union Territory administration identifies eligible farmer families under the scheme guidelines. Check your status through the official portal or mobile app.

Scheme: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)
Section: Overview
PM POSHAN is a centrally sponsored scheme that provides one hot cooked nutritious meal per school day to children studying in government and government-aided primary and upper primary classes.

metadata.schemeName: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)

text:
Scheme: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)
Section: Benefits
Provides hot cooked meals providing 450 calories and 12g protein for primary classes (I-V), and 700 calories and 20g protein for upper primary classes (VI-VIII). Aims to improve the nutritional status of children, encourage school attendance, and promote social equity.

metadata.schemeName: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)

text:
Scheme: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)
Section: Eligibility
All students enrolled in government, local body, and government-aided primary and upper primary schools, as well as Special Training Centers (STCs) across India.

metadata.schemeName: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)

text:
Scheme: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)
Section: Documents
School enrollment record. No separate individual documentation or paperwork is required by students or parents.

metadata.schemeName: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)

text:
Scheme: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)
Section: Application
Automatic entitlement upon enrollment and attendance in any participating government or government-aided school. No application process needed.

metadata.schemeName: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)

text:
Scheme: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
Section: Overview
PM SVANidhi is a micro-credit scheme launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs to provide collateral-free working capital loans to street vendors to resume and expand their livelihoods.

metadata.schemeName: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

text:
Scheme: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
Section: Benefits
Provides initial working capital loan up to ₹10,000; second tranche up to ₹20,000; and third tranche up to ₹50,000 upon timely repayment. Offers an interest subsidy of 7% per annum credited quarterly to the beneficiary's bank account, plus monthly cashback up to ₹100 for digital transactions.

metadata.schemeName: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

text:
Scheme: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
Section: Eligibility
Available to all street vendors, hawkers, and cart vendors engaged in vending in urban and peri-urban areas on or before the qualifying scheme dates, possessing a Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from local Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).

metadata.schemeName: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

text:
Scheme: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
Section: Documents
Aadhaar card, Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Urban Local Body, active bank account passbook, and Aadhaar-linked mobile number.

metadata.schemeName: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

text:
Scheme: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
Section: Application
Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or visit a nearby Common Service Center (CSC). Authenticate using Aadhaar, submit vending details, select your preferred lending institution, and submit.

metadata.schemeName: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

text:
Scheme: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
Section: Overview
PM Vishwakarma is a Central Sector Scheme designed to support traditional artisans and craftspeople who work with their hands and tools across 18 traditional family trades.

Scheme: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
Section: Benefits
Provides official PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card, 5-7 days basic training and 15 days advanced training with ₹500/day stipend, a ₹15,000 digital voucher grant for purchasing modern toolkits, and collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹1,00,000 (1st tranche) and ₹2,00,000 (2nd tranche) at a concessional interest rate of 5%.

Scheme: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
Section: Eligibility
Indian artisans and craftspeople engaged in one of the 18 specified traditional trades on self-employment basis. Minimum age 18 years. Limited to one member per family. Must not have availed similar government loans in the last 5 years.

Scheme: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
Section: Documents
Aadhaar card linked to mobile number, bank account details, ration card or family composition declaration, and trade verification declaration.

Scheme: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
Section: Application
Register through Common Service Centers (CSCs) on pmvishwakarma.gov.in using Aadhaar biometric authentication. Applications pass through 3-tier verification (Gram Panchayat/ULB, District Implementation Committee, and Screening Committee).

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
Section: Overview
PMAY-G is a rural housing programme of the Ministry of Rural Development. Its stated aim is to provide pucca houses with basic amenities to eligible rural households, including houseless households and households living in kutcha or dilapidated houses.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
Section: Benefits
The programme provides housing assistance under applicable guidelines. Assistance amounts, convergence benefits, and implementation details can vary by location and current guidelines.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
Section: Eligibility
Eligibility is determined through official identification and scheme processes for rural households. Final eligibility and beneficiary selection are determined by the responsible authorities under current PMAY-G rules.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
Section: Documents
Check the official PMAY-G portal or local rural-development authority for the current documents and verification requirements.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
Section: Application
Use the official PMAY-G portal to check available services and status, or contact the local rural-development authority for beneficiary identification and application support.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
Section: Overview
PMAY-U is an urban housing scheme of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs that supports the Housing for All objective for eligible urban households.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
Section: Benefits
The programme supports affordable housing through applicable components and current guidelines. The kind and amount of assistance depend on the relevant component, location, and approved application.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
Section: Eligibility
Official scheme information lists income categories and housing conditions among its checks. Applicants and family members generally must meet the current scheme conditions, including the applicable no-pucca-house and location requirements. Authorities make the final determination.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
Section: Documents
The official application process may require identity, residence, income, bank, and housing-related documents. Confirm the current requirements on the official PMAY-U portal before applying.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
Section: Application
Use the official PMAY-U portal and select the current application option. Read the applicable eligibility criteria before submitting information or Aadhaar-authentication consent.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
Section: Overview
PMFBY is a Government of India crop-insurance scheme intended to support farmers against crop loss or damage from specified unforeseen events.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
Section: Benefits
The scheme provides crop-insurance support for specified crop losses. Official guidance states that farmer premium is capped at 2% of sum insured for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for annual commercial or horticultural crops; other applicable premium support is provided under scheme rules.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
Section: Eligibility
Coverage depends on notified crops, notified areas, seasons, and applicable scheme guidelines. Farmers should confirm eligibility, enrolment dates, and coverage with the official portal, their bank, insurer, or local agriculture office.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
Section: Documents
Required documents and enrolment details can vary by season, State, crop, and enrolment channel. Confirm the current list through the official PMFBY portal or your enrolment channel.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
Section: Application
Use the Farmer Corner on the official PMFBY portal to apply for crop insurance or contact the relevant bank, insurer, or agriculture authority for the notified season.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
Section: Overview
PMGKAY is a food-security programme that provides free foodgrains to eligible ration-card holders covered under the National Food Security Act framework.

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)

text:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
Section: Benefits
Official myScheme information states that Antyodaya Anna Yojana families receive 35 kg of foodgrains per family per month and Priority Household beneficiaries receive 5 kg per person per month, subject to current rules and identification. Foodgrains are provided free of cost under the programme.

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)

text:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
Section: Eligibility
Eligibility is for Antyodaya Anna Yojana and Priority Household categories identified under the applicable food-security processes. State and Union Territory authorities determine card categories and final entitlement.

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)

text:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
Section: Documents
Use a ration card and, where applicable, the identity or authentication requirements specified by the local fair-price shop and State or Union Territory authority.

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)

text:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
Section: Application
Eligible beneficiaries collect their entitlement at a fair-price shop. Check ration-card status and local procedures with the responsible food-distribution authority.

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)

text:
Scheme: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
Section: Overview
Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the flagship national public health insurance fund of the Government of India that provides free health coverage for secondary and tertiary healthcare hospitalizations to low income citizens.

metadata.schemeName: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)

text:
Scheme: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
Section: Benefits
Provides cashless and paperless health coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across all empaneled public and private hospitals nationwide. Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses including diagnostic tests and medicines.

metadata.schemeName: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)

text:
Scheme: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
Section: Eligibility
Targeted at families identified based on deprivation and occupational criteria as per the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 database. There is no restriction on family size, age, or gender.

metadata.schemeName: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)

text:
Scheme: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
Section: Documents
Official documents include Aadhaar card or Ration card, government-issued photo ID proof, and an active mobile number for authentication and Golden Card generation.

metadata.schemeName: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)

text:
Scheme: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
Section: Application
Check eligibility online at mera.pmjay.gov.in or visit a nearby Common Service Center (CSC) or empaneled hospital. Carry Aadhaar Card and Ration Card to the Ayushman Mitra help desk, undergo biometric e-KYC verification, and receive the Ayushman Golden Card.

metadata.schemeName: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)

text:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
Section: Overview
PMJJBY is a one-year renewable term-life-insurance scheme that provides cover for death due to any cause.

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

text:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
Section: Benefits
The official Department of Financial Services FAQ states that Rs. 2 lakh is payable on the subscriber's death due to any cause. The stated annual premium is Rs. 436 per subscriber, subject to current scheme terms.

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

text:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
Section: Eligibility
The official FAQ states that eligible participating bank or post-office account holders aged 18 to 50 may join, subject to scheme terms. Check the current terms with the participating institution before enrolling.

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

text:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
Section: Documents
The participating bank or post office can confirm the current consent, account, and identification requirements.

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

text:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
Section: Application
Enrol through a participating bank or post office account and provide the required auto-debit consent under the current scheme process.

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

text:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
Section: Overview
Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana provides collateral-free institutional credit up to ₹10 Lakh (and up to ₹20 Lakh under enhanced category) to micro and small non-farm enterprises for income-generating activities.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
Section: Benefits
Offers collateral-free loans across categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,001 to ₹5 Lakh), Tarun (₹5,00,001 to ₹10 Lakh), and Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 Lakh). No third-party collateral or mortgage is required, and a Mudra debit card is issued for working capital withdrawals.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
Section: Eligibility
Any Indian citizen with a viable business plan for non-farm income-generating activities such as manufacturing, processing, trading, or service sector. Borrower must not be a defaulter with any financial institution.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
Section: Documents
Identity proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN card), address proof (electricity bill, ration card), business project report or quotation for machinery/supplies, and bank statements for the past 6 months.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
Section: Application
Prepare a business project summary and apply online through the Udyami Mitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), Small Finance Bank, or micro-finance institution.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
Section: Overview
PMSBY is a one-year renewable personal-accident-insurance scheme that offers cover for death or disability due to accident.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
Section: Benefits
The official Department of Financial Services FAQ lists Rs. 2 lakh for accidental death or certain total and irrecoverable disabilities, and Rs. 1 lakh for certain partial permanent disabilities. The stated annual premium is Rs. 20 per member, subject to current scheme terms.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
Section: Eligibility
Eligible participating bank or post-office account holders may subscribe subject to current scheme terms. Confirm age, account, and other conditions with the participating institution.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
Section: Documents
The participating bank or post office can confirm the current consent, account, and identification requirements.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
Section: Application
Enrol through a participating bank or post office account and provide the required auto-debit consent under the current scheme process.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
Section: Overview
PMUY is a Government of India scheme intended to make clean LPG cooking fuel available to eligible poor households, especially rural and deprived households that may otherwise use traditional cooking fuels.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
Section: Benefits
Eligible beneficiaries receive a deposit-free LPG connection. Official PMUY information says the support covers the cylinder security deposit, regulator, hose, consumer card, and installation-related charges; the first refill and stove are also provided free of cost under the stated benefits.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
Section: Eligibility
The applicant must be an adult woman aged 18 or above from a poor household under the prescribed declaration process, and the household must not already have an LPG connection from an Oil Marketing Company. Current scheme rules and verification determine final eligibility.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
Section: Documents
Official PMUY information lists KYC, family-composition documentation or permitted alternative declaration, Aadhaar for the beneficiary and relevant adult family members, proof of address where applicable, and bank account number with IFSC code.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
Section: Application
Apply for a PMUY connection through the official PMUY services or an authorised LPG distributor. Complete the required KYC and verification steps.

Scheme: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
Section: Overview
Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is a government-backed small savings scheme launched under the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign, designed to support the education and marriage expenses of female children.

Scheme: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
Section: Benefits
Offers high government-guaranteed interest rate (around 8.2% p.a. compounded annually) and complete tax exemption under Section 80C on deposit, interest accrued, and withdrawal. The account matures after 21 years from the date of opening or upon marriage after age 18.

Scheme: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
Section: Eligibility
The account can be opened by parents or legal guardians in the name of a girl child from birth up to age 10. Maximum two accounts are permitted per family (with exceptions for twins or triplets).

Scheme: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
Section: Documents
Birth certificate of the girl child, identity proof and address proof of the parent or legal guardian (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID), and passport-size photographs of child and parent.

Scheme: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
Section: Application
Visit any designated post office or authorised commercial bank branch, submit the completed SSY application form along with birth certificate, guardian KYC documents, and initial deposit (minimum ₹250).

Scheme: Stand-Up India Scheme
Section: Overview
Stand-Up India is a scheme designed to promote grassroots entrepreneurship among women and Scheduled Caste (SC) / Scheduled Tribe (ST) individuals by facilitating institutional bank loans for greenfield ventures.

Scheme: Stand-Up India Scheme
Section: Benefits
Facilitates composite bank loans (term loan and working capital) between ₹10,00,000 and ₹1,00,00,000 to cover up to 85% of project cost for setting up new enterprises. Includes handholding and mentorship support through SIDBI.

Scheme: Stand-Up India Scheme
Section: Eligibility
Borrower must be a Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), or Woman entrepreneur aged 18 years or above. The enterprise must be a greenfield project in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or the trading sector. In non-individual enterprises, 51% shareholding must be held by SC/ST or woman.

Scheme: Stand-Up India Scheme
Section: Documents
Identity and address proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport), caste certificate (for SC/ST), detailed project report (DPR), bank statements for the past 6 months, and company registration documents if applicable.

Scheme: Stand-Up India Scheme
Section: Application
Register online at standupmitra.in or directly visit a commercial bank branch. Connect with handholding agencies or apply directly to lead lenders with your DPR and requisite documentation.
